faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU Krishnagiri) in Tamil Nadu for filling vacant positions under child welfare and protection schemes.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in this notification?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Support Person, specifically designated to handle POCSO cases and provide necessary assistance within the district.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Support Person position under this recruitment notification issued by DCPU Krishnagiri.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form along with required documents is 15 October 2026. Applications must reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for DCPU Krishnagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post or in person to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates along with a minimum of 3 years of experience in fields related to children's education, health, upbringing, or protection such as social work, sociology, law, psychology, or child development.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for applicants is 25 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before submitting their application forms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of up to Rs. 10,000/- per month, which includes the applicable travel allowance for official duties.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DCPU Krishnagiri Support Person?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of the submitted offline applications followed by appointment as a Support Person for handling POCSO cases in the district.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: The completed application should be sent to the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Room No. 99 & 100, District Collectorate, 2nd Floor, Krishnagiri - 635 115.
